sloka: प्रहारे च पराक्रान्तः शूरः पंचत्वम् आगतः ।पति हीना तु या नारी कामम् भवतु पुत्रिणी ॥४-२३-१२॥
transliteration: prahāre ca parākrāntaḥ śūraḥ paṁcatvam āgataḥ ।pati hīnā tu yā nārī kāmam bhavatu putriṇī ॥4-23-12॥

translations.english: 'Even if a woman without husband, is blessed with sons and abundant wealth and grain, still learned people call her a widow.
